hosting.comment: This project has been migrated from Firebase to self-hosted server.

notes.instructions:
1. Build the project: npm run build
2. Upload the 'dist' folder contents to your server public_html directory
3. Ensure backend PHP files are in the 'backend' folder on your server
4. Update VITE_API_BASE_URL in .env.production to match your server URL
5. Configure your server for SPA routing: redirect all requests to index.html except for existing files
